    Proposition 7.2(1): W(P) ≅ ℤ^{n−1} ⊕ G_ab #

    weights-and-parameters.tex (prop:integral-ray-weights(1)): "There is an identification W(P) = (I_𝓛)_G […] the class θ_g of e_{gx} − e_x is independent of the object x, and g ↦ θ_g identifies G_ab with a direct summand of W(P) with complement ℤ^{n−1}: W(P) ≅ ℤ^{n−1} ⊕ G_ab."

    With the deck group G of the base component (Hs, the stabilizer of the component 𝓛₀ of the base object in the deck group of the coned complex; see RayWeights.lean):

    • W(P) = (I_𝓛₀)_G: [Σ v_o e_o] ↦ Σ v_o ζ(o) is an isomorphism (coinvEquiv), with inverse βW built from Ψ;
    • the comparison Ψ of RayWeights.lean is an isomorphism onto the vectors with coordinate sum zero times G_ab (ΨW_ΦW, WPequiv), hence W(P) ≃ ℤ^{n−1} × G_ab (WPequivFree);
    • θ_g = ζ(gx) − ζ(x) does not depend on x in 𝓛₀ and is the G_ab summand under WPequivFree (theta_summand). W(P) is free of finite rank (WP_free, WP_finite).
